library.name: Original Editorial & Civic Design Architecture Corpus
library.ipAndGovernanceNotice: All tokens, container rules, and implementation recipes in this registry are original first-principles specifications developed for high-density editorial, statutory, and trauma-informed public-interest systems. No third-party trademarked names, proprietary brand assets, or redistributed external stylesheets are claimed or bundled. Any commercial offering remains strictly separate from Maps With Teeth's public-interest civic work.
library.organizationModel: DUAL_INDEX (1. By Architectural Archetype -> 2. By Validated Container & UX Pattern)

archival-monograph.name: Archival Monograph & Evidentiary Ledger
archival-monograph.principle: High-contrast nocturnal ink (#0E0D0C) paired with warm reading ivory (#F8F5EE), crimson seal rules (#971F26), and strictly decoupled semantic evidentiary states.

swiss-hairline-editorial.name: Swiss Hairline Editorial Grid
swiss-hairline-editorial.principle: Eliminates 4-sided card boxes in favor of gallery-white canvas (#FDFCFA), 1px vertical column hairlines, oversized serif index numerals, and underline-only tab bars.

tonal-gallery-monograph.name: Borderless Tonal Gallery
tonal-gallery-monograph.principle: Replaces drawn borders with subtle tonal surface shifts (#F6F4EF canvas -> #FDFBF7 cards -> #ECE8DF recessed wells), lighter 400/500 serif weights, and rounded pill controls.

technical-field-instrument.name: Tactile Technical Specification & Field Manual
technical-field-instrument.domain: Protocol Schemas, Cryptographic Receipts & Statutory Registers
technical-field-instrument.principle: Cool technical paper (#EFEFE9), 1px dashed specification dividers, tabular-numeral alignment, and tactile switch controls with semantic status dots.

trauma-informed-civic.name: Trauma-Informed Civic & Statutory Clarity
trauma-informed-civic.domain: Public Service Eligibility, Legal Remedies & Crisis Navigation
trauma-informed-civic.principle: Maximizes comprehension under stress: replaces 4-sided warning boxes with borderless left-rule editorial margin notes, enforces 44px–48px minimum touch targets, and maintains high-visibility focus rings.

floating-exhibit-essay.name: Open-Canvas Essay with Floating Specimen Sheets
floating-exhibit-essay.principle: Narrative prose sits directly on warm parchment (#F9F6F0) with zero outer wrapper box; interactive specimens float as shadow-lifted white sheets with docked provenance footers.

shared-wall-bento-grid.title: Pattern 01: Shared-1px-Wall Relational Grid
shared-wall-bento-grid.problemSolved: Eliminates parallel double-borders between adjacent cards by placing cells inside a 1px gap grid where the container background forms the shared 1px hairline wall.

three-weight-horizontal-rule-hierarchy.title: Pattern 02: Three-Weight Horizontal Rule Hierarchy
three-weight-horizontal-rule-hierarchy.problemSolved: Encodes 3 levels of data hierarchy without vertical side borders: 3px solid top section anchor, 1px solid sub-table header, and 1px dotted data row dividers.

docked-provenance-exhibit-frame.title: Pattern 03: Single Exhibit Frame with Docked Provenance Footer
docked-provenance-exhibit-frame.problemSolved: Prevents separate floating disclaimer or citation boxes below cards by docking statutory authority and verification status into a muted bottom footer strip of the exhibit frame.

left-rule-editorial-callout.title: Pattern 04: Borderless Left-Rule Editorial Margin Callout
left-rule-editorial-callout.problemSolved: Replaces 4-sided warning cages and heavy dark disclaimer slabs with a borderless 3px–4px left rule and subtle parchment tint.

recessed-segmented-disclosure-track.title: Pattern 05: Recessed Segmented Disclosure Track
recessed-segmented-disclosure-track.problemSolved: Replaces clusters of 3–5 heavy bordered tab buttons with a single recessed track and a floating ivory active pill.
